data.text: Praise the LORD! Praise, servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
data.titulo: Praise the LORD’s Name in Every Place and Age

data.text: Blessed be the name of the LORD from now on and forever.
From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the LORD is to be praised.
The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
data.titulo: The LORD on High Looks Down to Help

data.text: Who is like the LORD our God, who is seated on high,
who stoops to look on the heavens and the earth?
He raises the weak from the dust and lifts the needy from the refuse heap,
to seat them with nobles, with the nobles of his people.
He gives the barren woman a home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!
